en.summary: OpenAI disclosed that its red team found an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability in the Brotli compression library. Attackers can execute code on affected systems by sending or replying with malicious compressed data, without creating a user account. The flaw affects software that embeds Brotli, including Node.js, Bun, and Envoy; unpatched servers that accept compressed input (such as clients accepting curl --compressed) can be taken over by a malicious peer.
en.reason: During a red-teaming exercise, OpenAI found an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability in Brotli that lets attackers run code via malicious compressed data on unpatched servers accepting compressed input, affecting embedded uses in Node.js, Bun and Envoy.
